name: ai-agents-terminal
description: Launch the AI CLI agents installed on your machine (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / …) from a status-bar button, with YOLO auto-approve and Resume-session toggles, terminal-profile integration, and a configurable agent catalog.

aiAgentsTerminal.yoloMode.markdownDescription: YOLO mode: launch agents with their `skipFlag` (auto-approve) so they run without permission prompts. Toggle it from the `$(zap)` status-bar button or `Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Y`.

aiAgentsTerminal.resumeMode.markdownDescription: Resume mode: launch agents with their `resumeFlag` to continue the most recent session. Toggle it from the `$(history)` status-bar button or `Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+R`.

aiAgentsTerminal.agents.markdownDescription:
User overrides / additions merged on top of the built-in catalog in `agents.json`. Override a built-in by matching its `command` (only the fields you set replace it); set `enabled: false` to hide a built-in; use a `command` not in `agents.json` to add a custom agent.

Changes apply immediately — the picker re-reads this setting every time it opens and the Terminal profiles are re-registered. A newly added `command` may need a window reload if another window currently owns the PATH probe (it refreshes at most once every 15s).

Example — change Claude's resume flag and hide Gemini:
```json
"aiAgentsTerminal.agents": [
  { "command": "claude", "resumeFlag": "--continue" },
  { "command": "gemini", "enabled": false }
]
```

Launch args are ordered `baseArgs` → `skipFlag` → `resumeFlag`; `skipFlag` is only appended when YOLO mode is on, `resumeFlag` only when Resume mode is on.

defaultSnippets.label: Override a built-in agent
defaultSnippets.description: Change only the fields you set on an agent from agents.json, matched by command.

defaultSnippets.label: Hide a built-in agent
defaultSnippets.description: Keep the agent in agents.json but stop showing it in the launcher.

defaultSnippets.label: Add a custom agent
defaultSnippets.description: Add an agent that is not in agents.json (command only is enough).

command.markdownDescription: CLI binary launched in the terminal (also used for PATH detection). Required. Match a built-in's `command` to override it; use a new one to add a custom agent.

displayName.markdownDescription: Name shown in the launcher. Defaults to `command` for custom agents.

baseArgs.markdownDescription: Space-separated arguments always passed to the command, before any mode flag (e.g. `agent` for `cursor-agent`, `run` for `kilo`).

skipFlag.markdownDescription: Space-separated flag appended when YOLO mode is on (e.g. `--dangerously-skip-permissions` for Claude, `--yolo` for Gemini). Leave it empty to launch with no auto-approve flag.

resumeFlag.markdownDescription: Space-separated flag appended when Resume mode is on, to continue the most recent session (e.g. `-r` for Claude, `--resume` for Codex and Cursor). Omit it and the agent launches normally even in Resume mode.

iconFile.markdownDescription: Icon filename under the extension's `media/agents` folder (e.g. `claude.png`). If omitted, a default terminal icon is used.

enabled.markdownDescription: Set to `false` to hide an agent without deleting its entry.

id.markdownDescription: Optional stable id (defaults to `command`). An override may also match a built-in by its `id`.

aiAgentsTerminal.installedAgents.markdownDescription: Internal cache of AI agent commands detected on PATH. Maintained automatically — do not edit by hand. (internal)
